match_logpolar_z — 3D match_pose op

• Data kinds: voxel × voxel → rot_scale

• Call: import match3d; match3d.match_logpolar_z(a, b, device='cpu', project='mip', nt=360, nr=192) (or ops3d.get("match_logpolar_z"))

• GPU: this op has a GPU path (device="cuda")

Usage

Recover rotation about z and isotropic scale by log-polar × phase correlation (Fourier-Mellin).
